open_points.subject: A13 confirmation input binding and M20/A16 digest binding
open_points.text: a submission whose action, target, version or inputs differ from those the step showed is refused (test 12).
open_points.question: Must Registry compare the actual bound values, or may equality of the digest required by M20 and A16 stand for equality even when distinct inputs have the same digest? The texts must reconcile this absolute refusal guarantee with M20's “the inputs it is bound to, by their digest” and A16's digest binding.
options: Compare the actual structured values; use a digest only as an accelerator and resolve equality against the values.
Treat equal digests as equal inputs, accepting the residual possibility that different inputs collide.
Define a collision-resolving representation whose equality is equivalent to equality of every bound input.
open_points.default_guess: Compare the actual structured values and retain any digest only as an accelerator.

witness.initial: A session has a valid pending confirmation for input tuple I1; a distinct tuple I2 has the same digest under the chosen digest procedure.
events: The owner submits the pending confirmation value with I2 before it expires.
Registry passes the owner-session and CSRF checks.
outcomes: The actual-value reading of A13 refuses and consumes the confirmation because I2 differs from I1.
The digest reading of M20/A16 treats the binding as equal and continues the action.
witness.observer: The owner sees refusal versus acceptance, and the store may contain different submitted values.

open_points.subject: A13 and A16 import confirmation inputs
open_points.text:
and its inputs — for the import, the file's digest
   and the picks: a submission whose action, target, version or inputs
   differ from those the step showed is refused (test 12).
open_points.question: Is the import confirmation bound only to the file digest and ordered picks named here, or also to every name, alias, Customer name, kind, tax-id choice and other Customer value that A16 rules 2 and 6 say the mapping showed and bound? The complete import input set must be stated.
options: Bind the file identity or digest, ordered picks, every project name and alias, and every Customer value shown by the step.
Bind only the file digest and ordered picks; rebuild or take the remaining mapping values at submission.
Bind an explicitly named immutable mapping value containing all displayed choices.
open_points.default_guess: Bind an immutable mapping containing the file identity, ordered picks, names, aliases and all Customer values.

witness.initial: A clean import confirmation step was shown for file F and picks P with alias A1 and Customer kind person.
events: Before expiry, the owner submits the same confirmation value, file digest and picks but supplies alias A2 or Customer kind company.
outcomes: A narrow reading of the changed A13 phrase finds the named import inputs unchanged and applies the altered value.
A16's binding rule and the broad reading of “any input” refuse the submission and consume the confirmation.
witness.observer: The owner sees acceptance versus refusal; on acceptance the imported Project or Customer has different facts from the shown mapping.

open_points.subject: A13 confirmation mismatch and A04 failure ordering
open_points.text:
A submission that passes those checks when the
   pending one has expired is refused and clears it, whatever value it
   gives.
open_points.question: At which A04 stage are an expired confirmation and a mismatch of its bound action, target, version or inputs checked, and which refusal is returned when one coincides with a later failure such as a nonexistent target, invalid input or stale revision?
options: Treat expiry and every binding mismatch as part of A04 stage (1), before existence, value and revision checks.
At stage (1) check only the submitted confirmation value; report binding mismatches at the A04 stage belonging to the mismatching target, input or version.
Consume the confirmation at stage (1) but return the first independently failing target, value or revision check.
open_points.default_guess: Treat expiry and all binding checks as confirmation checks at A04 stage (1), consuming the carried confirmation before any later-stage refusal.

witness.initial: A valid pending confirmation was shown for revision 3; the record is now at revision 4.
events: The owner submits the correct pending value while stating revision 2, which is both different from the shown version and stale.
outcomes: A stage-(1) binding check answers a confirmation-binding refusal.
A stage-(5) interpretation answers a stale-revision refusal.
witness.observer: The owner sees a different refusal even though both implementations consume the pending confirmation and change no record.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession operation and hidden PendingConfirmation representation
open_points.text:
How the session
   keeps what it binds is the owner session operation's (State 5), not a rule
   here.
open_points.question: State 5 must decide what bound facts callers supply to and may rely on from the owner-session operation; generation must choose the hidden representation without weakening the required comparison. Which contract-visible value and hidden representation are used?
options: State 5 passes a structured immutable binding; generation stores that value together with any digest used for lookup.
State 5 passes canonical serialized bytes; generation stores those bytes and a digest while resolving equality byte-for-byte.
State 5 passes a typed binding identifier plus the complete binding value; generation chooses storage and verifies the value on submission.
consequences: Structured values make action-specific equality explicit but require State 5 to define every field and ordering rule.
Canonical bytes centralize equality but require canonicalization rules for all input types and versions.
An identifier plus the complete value separates lookup from equality but adds another temporary session fact.
open_points.requirement: a submission whose action, target, version or inputs differ from those the step showed is refused (test 12).
open_points.default_guess: Have State 5 pass a typed immutable binding containing every shown value, and let generation store it with an optional digest while comparing the complete binding.
